image_description: A close-up, slightly angled shot of a laminated restaurant menu page. The menu features a large central photograph of a dish (appearing to be a savory pancake or dumpling with vegetables) inside a circular frame. Above the image is the restaurant name 'DIN TAI FUNG' in stylized red and green lettering, followed by smaller text. Below the image are item descriptions and prices in English and Chinese characters. The menu is encased in a clear plastic sleeve or laminate, indicated by surface reflections.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The smaller text at the very bottom, particularly the ingredient list or fine print, shows signs of AI-generated text artifacts. Characters are malformed, spacing is inconsistent, and some symbols look like pseudo-Chinese or garbled Latin characters rather than legible text. The price '$10.95' is clear, but the surrounding descriptive text degrades into gibberish upon close inspection.

The texture of the food (dumpling/pancake skin) appears slightly overly smooth and plastic-like, lacking the fine micro-texture of real fried dough or steamed wrapper. It has a 'waxy' AI-rendered quality.

The perspective of the menu binder/sleeve on the left is slightly ambiguous. The reflection lines don't perfectly align with the curvature of the page, suggesting minor geometric inconsistency in how the plastic sleeve interacts with the paper.
